description: Get commit proofs for records, as one CAR (proofs/1).

main.description: Get commit proofs for records, as one CAR (proofs/1). Each item is verified independently; a cid null item proves absence. First pass (M6).

output.description: CAR v1. Root: DAG-CBOR manifest {v: 1, items: [{uri, cid: CID | null, commit: CID}]} (at most 25 items), then deduplicated blocks (sync.md proofs/1). At most 8 MiB.
